summary: Iteration 3 — WhatsApp-first form submissions verified for all 3 forms (Hero Quote, Contact, Free Consultation). Blocking compile issues (syntax garbage in Hero.jsx + undefined WHATSAPP in Contact.jsx) fixed to unblock testing. All 9 backend pytest tests pass. All 3 UI forms open wa.me/919711623561 with correctly prefilled messages (name/email/phone/service/budget/details/brief), show correct success UI, correct toast, and still persist to Mongo `leads` with expected `source` labels. 28 standalone wa.me links on home + across all pages point to +91 97116 23561. Zero console errors on Home/About/Services/Work/Blog/Contact.

ui_bugs.issue: Success heading reads 'Sent.' but review request spec said heading should be 'Opening WhatsApp…' for consistency with Consultation modal. Functionally works (toast + wa.me open both correct), but heading text deviates from spec.

action_items: OPTIONAL (spec polish): Update Hero.jsx success state heading from 'Sent.' to 'Opening WhatsApp…' to match Consultation modal wording per review request spec 1(b). Toast + form flow are already correct.

OPTIONAL: Contact.jsx best-effort lead POST hard-codes source='website' (from form default) — review spec did not require a distinct `source` for contact page, but for parity with hero-quote-form / free-consultation-modal you may want source='contact-page-form'.
critical_code_review_comments: BLOCKING (fixed by me): Hero.jsx had 13 lines of duplicate garbage content after the closing '}' (lines 250-262) causing a Babel/ESLint 'Missing semicolon' syntax error and preventing the frontend from compiling. Trimmed file to 249 lines.

BLOCKING (fixed by me): Contact.jsx line 94 referenced an undefined identifier `WHATSAPP` (removed during refactor to waUrl helper) which would ReferenceError on /contact render. Replaced with `waUrl(WA_MESSAGES.general)`.
waUrlFromForm() correctly encodes emoji + newlines + special chars — verified by decoding captured window.open URLs.
Best-effort backend save is truly non-blocking: axios.post(...).catch(() => {}) is fire-and-forget; UX proceeds regardless.
Carried over from earlier iterations: GET /api/leads is unauthenticated and exposes lead PII — recommend admin auth before production.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_-prefixed leads created during UI flows (TEST_HeroUser, TEST_ConsultUser, TEST_ContactUser) + 1 from backend pytest. All 4 cleaned up post-test via db.leads.delete_many({name: /^TEST_/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 form → WhatsApp handoffs are working. To capture window.open in playwright, use page.add_init_script to override window.open into an array; do NOT use popup event because handler opens tab in same JS tick before playwright's popup listener can attach. Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Test leads prefixed with TEST_ are safe to clean via mongo delete_many. Note the Hero success heading spec deviation ('Sent.' vs 'Opening WhatsApp…') if the main agent updates copy.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of frontend build failure: Hero.jsx had duplicate content pasted after the file's closing brace (leftover from a prior edit) — Babel choked on line 250. Root cause of Contact page render failure: refactor to waUrl helper removed the old `const WHATSAPP = ...` but left a stale JSX reference `href={WHATSAPP}`. Both fixed. All 3 WhatsApp flows now: (a) open wa.me/919711623561?text=... with correctly URL-encoded prefilled form fields, (b) show the correct success state, (c) fire the 'Opening WhatsApp' toast, (d) persist a best-effort lead doc to Mongo with the correct source label.
